item.description: Ikkis Box Office Collection: Indian cinema legend Dharmendra's last film, " Ikkis," was released in theaters on January 1, 2026, and is receiving a tremendous response from audiences (Ikkis movie review). Directed by Sriram Raghavan, the film is based on the true story of Second Lieutenant Arun Khetarpal, a hero of the 1971 Indo-Pak war. The film's thrilling story and powerful performances have drawn audiences to the theaters. Now, all eyes are on "Ikkis"'s box office collection on opening day.
